notes:
Closing PiP now stops playback and notification audio in both players, even with background playback enabled or late mode callbacks. Expanding visible PiP keeps playing. Compatibility closure uses the existing isolated-process exit path.
Guide details and the update dialog now use provided Material typography, dividers and standard buttons.
Automatic update checks now run during compatibility playback too. Available updates can be rechecked after activity/process loss; failed checks have a five-minute retry eligibility window rather than twelve hours. Successful no-update checks retain twelve hours. Later and Download acknowledgements are shared across players; manual checking remains available.
Stream buffers, decoder profiles and EPG providers are unchanged.
